top_groups_last_seen 597e7c7f7b33.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
top_groups_last_seen 597e7c7f7b33.sql:
SELECT "Group", "Actions", "Last seen" FROM (-- Actions are the views and product events sent with the group_id. Users
-- are distinct per day, so the range figure is the busiest day's: the same
-- person on two days cannot be told apart from two people. First seen is
-- the first event the files hold for the group (identities), which also
-- names it.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT group_id AS id, day, count(*) AS actions, count(DISTINCT nullif(user_id, '')) AS users
  FROM events
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND family IN ('views', 'product') AND group_id <> ''
    AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
  GROUP BY group_id, day
)
SELECT COALESCE(i.name, d.id) AS "Group",
       SUM(d.actions) AS "Actions",
       MAX(d.users) AS "Peak daily users",
       count(DISTINCT d.day) AS "Active days",
       MIN(i.first_seen::DATE) AS "First seen",
       MAX(d.day) AS "Last seen"
FROM d
LEFT JOIN identities i ON i.project_id = 1 AND i.kind = 'group' AND i.id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, i.name
ORDER BY SUM(d.actions) DESC, d.id
LIMIT 100
) ORDER BY "Actions" DESC, "Group"

top_users_last_seen 36edb0d2525f.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
top_users_last_seen 36edb0d2525f.sql:
SELECT "User", "Actions", "Last seen" FROM (-- Actions are the views and product events sent with the user_id. First
-- seen is the first event the files hold for the user (identities), which
-- also names it.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT user_id AS id, day,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE family = 'views') AS views,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE family = 'product') AS events
  FROM events
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND family IN ('views', 'product') AND user_id <> ''
    AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
  GROUP BY user_id, day
)
SELECT COALESCE(i.name, d.id) AS "User",
       SUM(d.views + d.events) AS "Actions",
       SUM(d.events) AS "Events",
       SUM(d.views) AS "Views",
       count(DISTINCT d.day) AS "Active days",
       MIN(i.first_seen::DATE) AS "First seen",
       MAX(d.day) AS "Last seen"
FROM d
LEFT JOIN identities i ON i.project_id = 1 AND i.kind = 'user' AND i.id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, i.name
ORDER BY SUM(d.views + d.events) DESC, d.id
LIMIT 100
) ORDER BY "Actions" DESC, "User"
